title: (Pwn2Own) Huawei Reader Insecure Plugin Loading Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on vulnerable installations of Huawei Reader. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of plugins. The issue results from the storage of plugins in an insecure location. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute code in the context of the current user.
